items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: Vigory? Vigory, yeah. You don't remember his first name? No, I never did. I don't know if it was John.

ctx.x: Vigory? Vigory, yeah. You don't remember his first name? No, I never did. I don't know if it was John.
I'm sure we can find it out one more time. I imagine Louis Panzeri will know, because he knows all the teachers. You know Louis.
